browser_checks.name: Original material and structure assets render in the real game
browser_checks.observed: Overhead rooms, guardians, textured first-person stone corridors, a trap and the shared map are visible.

browser_checks.name: Pause and resume
browser_checks.observed: UI changes between 暂停 and 继续运转 / 开始运转; full-screen pause also changes the actual shared pause state.

browser_checks.name: Enter and return from possession
browser_checks.observed: Guard 1 becomes 亲自控制 with real 110/110 health, build tools become disabled, seven movement/combat controls appear; P restores management and enables construction.

browser_checks.name: Full-screen controls stay accessible
browser_checks.observed: Full-screen stage exposes pause, selected-guard possession, return to management, tool instructions and exit. Enter-guard and pause were activated by pointer; return and exit were additionally verified by keyboard activation of their actual visible buttons.

browser_checks.name: Guided excavation consumes budget and completes
browser_checks.observed: 接通训练场 + canvas Enter reduces 700 gold to 692 and creates one digging task. After starting normal time the queue reaches zero and guard 3 progresses to level 2.

browser_checks.name: Actual reload restores paused state
browser_checks.observed: Reload preserves the current gold, charges, room count and guard levels; restore message appears and resume remains an explicit action.

browser_checks.name: 390 by 844 responsive layout
browser_checks.observed: Document content width 375 <= viewport 390; game stage width 345.33 and height 215.83. All seven on-screen controls stay inside the stage and viewport.

browser_checks.name: Possession scrolls the game into view on a narrow screen
browser_checks.observed: After the sidebar possession action the stage appears at y=313.77 within the 844-high viewport, with health, return and movement controls visible.

browser_checks.name: Desktop layout
browser_checks.observed: Real desktop page and full-screen views were reviewed; a 1440-wide layout has content width 1425 with no horizontal overflow. Temporary viewport overrides were reset afterward.
